record.title: Resolve pinned APK-backed Auklet geometry from preserved physical maps
record.intent: Establish a bounded container-aware mapping contract offline before changing the process reader.
requirements: Commit and push admitted tasking before implementation. Use only preserved files; no physical or guest connection in this task.
Pin the previously acquired APK and embedded stock ELF; verify unique unencrypted stored ZIP entry, local and central header agreement, alignment, sizes, bounds and payload hash.

Resolve Auklet uniquely from APK-relative map offsets while distinguishing other mappings sharing the APK inode. Require coherent PT_LOAD bias, exact private permissions and file-backed cached-range geometry.

Reject ambiguity, wrong backing identity, incorrect offsets, unsafe permissions and malformed containers with deterministic controls. Preserve observations separately from predictions; do not claim fresh specimen APK identity or memory permissions.
Preserve a private result and publish only geometry, method, artifact hashes and limits. Commit and push the conclusion before successor execution.
acceptance: Pinned offline geometry and meaningful negative controls establish a candidate mapping contract or a precise retained failure.
